section_content: Beta Sigma is built on brotherhood, scholarship, and service. We seek men who want to grow academically, lead on campus, and give back to the community.
Rush is a mutual selection process. Come to our events, ask questions, and get to know the chapter. There is no obligation — just show up as yourself.
Prospective members must be enrolled full-time, maintain good academic standing, and demonstrate character aligned with our fraternity values.
Rush Week: August 25–31, 2026 | Interviews: September 1–3 | Bid Day: September 5, 2026
